guide.title: Korean BBQ in London: the West End, Paddington, Clerkenwell, and the boroughs south and east
guide.intro: Korean barbecue in London is cooked on a grill at the diner's own table, and fourteen rooms across eight boroughs work that way. Four are in the West End: Kingly Street in Soho, Lisle Street and Gerrard Place in Chinatown, and the Central Saint Giles Piazza in St Giles. Three more sit north and west of it, on Praed Street in Paddington, the Edgware Road at Little Venice and Pancras Square at King's Cross. Two are in Islington, on Rosebery Avenue and Whitecross Street. The remaining five spread south and east, to Royal Crest Avenue in Silvertown, Plowden Road in Kidbrooke, Lee High Road, The Broadway in Wimbledon and New Malden High Street. Some rooms hand the grate to the party; at Little Korea on Lisle Street the chefs grill the marinated meat at the table instead.

sections.heading: The West End: Soho, Chinatown and St Giles
sections.body:
Four of the fourteen stand inside the West End, three in Westminster and one in Camden.

Myung Ga occupies the ground floor of 1 Kingly Street in Soho, and its own menu heads the BBQ section 'You can grill meat or seafood on your table', with Kalbi, Bulgogi, Chicken BBQ, Deungsim, prawn and squid named beneath it. Little Korea is at 2-3 Lisle Street in Chinatown, where a homepage section headed 'K-BBQ On The Table' states that the chefs grill the marinated meat at the table rather than in the kitchen. Bab N Suul is at 1 Gerrard Place, also in Chinatown, where the cuts run from marinated bulgogi to A5 wagyu ribeye and are cooked on the grill at the table; its booking form makes the guest pick a table type of either BBQ or Regular Table.

SuperStar BBQ is at 4 Central Saint Giles Piazza, over the Camden boundary in St Giles. Its own About page describes a Korean restaurant specialising in table BBQ, with a menu written for the grill at the table and side dishes chosen to accompany the grill dishes, and gives hours of noon to 3pm and 5pm to 11pm, Monday to Friday.

sections.heading: Paddington, the Edgware Road and King's Cross
sections.body:
Three stand north and west of the West End, two in Westminster and one in Camden.

Zanchi is at 113-115 Praed Street in Paddington. Its own site describes the business as a Korean restaurant and barbecue whose dishes and barbecue tables are built around shared meals, and its Korean BBQ list of raw belly pork, beef sirloin and bulgogi is grilled at the table, with a separate side-dish block of lettuce, sliced chilli and garlic to wrap it in. Gogi is at 451 Edgware Road on the Little Venice stretch, where the operator's own About Us section describes marinated meats and fresh seafood prepared on individual grills at the table.

Kimchee occupies 2 Pancras Square at King's Cross, and the two rooms there are not the same. The downstairs Table BBQ room seats guests in semi-private booths with smokeless built-in grills at each table; the ground floor and terrace are cooked in an open-plan kitchen on a traditional charcoal grill, which is the chain's usual service elsewhere.

sections.heading: Clerkenwell and Whitecross Street
sections.body:
Two stand in Islington, one on Rosebery Avenue and one on Whitecross Street.

Kalbi Korean BBQ occupies Unit 1 of Rosebery Court at 36A Rosebery Avenue in Clerkenwell. Its own homepage states that the Korean BBQ is grilled at the table and describes the house as specialising in Korean table barbecue; the published hours are 6pm to 10.30pm Monday to Thursday and 5pm to 11pm Friday to Sunday.

Korean BBQ House is at 105-107 Whitecross Street in Finsbury. The operator's own site describes built-in tabletop grills that let guests cook fresh meat and seafood through the meal rather than take everything pre-cooked from the kitchen, and gives hours of noon to 9pm Monday to Thursday, 3pm to 10pm Friday, noon to 10pm Saturday and noon to 9pm Sunday. The EC1Y postcode sector falls in Islington, and the City of London boundary crosses Whitecross Street to the south, near Errol Street.

sections.heading: South and east: Silvertown, Kidbrooke, Lee, Wimbledon and New Malden
sections.body:
Five stand outside the central boroughs, in Newham, Greenwich, Lewisham, Merton and Kingston upon Thames.

Keonbae Barbeque & Beer runs two rooms: 20A Royal Crest Avenue on the Royal Wharf development in Silvertown, and 4 Plowden Road in Kidbrooke Village. One strapline covers both, 'Authentic Korean cuisine and grill on the table', which puts the grill at the table in each, and the operator's site carries a separate booking link for each branch. Cow Cow Korean BBQ & Hot Pot is at 47-49 Lee High Road in Lee, where the buffet menu heads a section 'Sizzle and Simmer at Your Table' and tells diners to grill premium meats and simmer fresh ingredients at the table, with a separate 'Fresh from Our Kitchen' section beside it.

Yori Wimbledon is at 86 The Broadway, where the branch's own page describes 'separated barbeque and non-barbeque dining areas' and the grill sits at the table in the barbeque one; the group's barbecue menu is raw meat by the cut, sold with a vegetable wrap set. Imone BBQ is at 171 High Street in New Malden, in the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames, where the operator's own picture captions describe meats set on the table for grilling and marinated cuts already on the grill.

faq.question: What counts as Korean barbecue at the table?
faq.answer: The grill sits in or on the diner's own table and the meat is cooked there, whether the party works the grate or a server does. A gas grate, a downdraft smokeless grill and a charcoal grate all count, and so does a removable grate staff swap out between rounds. A kitchen that grills the meat and sends it out already cooked is a different format however Korean the menu, and so are a bibimbap house, a fried-chicken house and a stone-bowl house, where a heated dolsot does the work instead. At Little Korea on Lisle Street the chefs do the grilling at the table, which is inside the definition; at Kimchee, Pancras Square, the downstairs room is inside it and the ground floor is not.

faq.question: Which boroughs do the fourteen sit in?
faq.answer: Eight. Westminster carries five: Myung Ga on Kingly Street, Little Korea on Lisle Street, Bab N Suul at Gerrard Place, Zanchi on Praed Street and Gogi on the Edgware Road. Islington carries two, Kalbi on Rosebery Avenue and Korean BBQ House on Whitecross Street, and Camden two, Kimchee at Pancras Square and SuperStar BBQ at Central Saint Giles. Newham, Greenwich, Lewisham, Merton and Kingston upon Thames carry one each: Keonbae at Royal Wharf in Silvertown, Keonbae at Kidbrooke, Cow Cow on Lee High Road, Yori on The Broadway in Wimbledon and Imone BBQ on New Malden High Street.

faq.question: Does any operator run more than one of these rooms?
faq.answer: Keonbae Barbeque & Beer runs two, at 20A Royal Crest Avenue in Silvertown and 4 Plowden Road in Kidbrooke, and its own site names both branches under one strapline with a separate booking link for each. Yori runs rooms elsewhere in England, and the Wimbledon page is the branch-specific one, describing 'separated barbeque and non-barbeque dining areas'. Kimchee runs several London rooms, and the Table BBQ format is the Pancras Square branch's own.

faq.question: Is the whole of Kimchee at Pancras Square a table-grill room?
faq.answer: No. The branch's own page separates a downstairs Table BBQ room, with semi-private booths and smokeless built-in grills at each table, from the ground floor and terrace, which are cooked in an open-plan kitchen on a traditional charcoal grill. Kitchen grilling is the usual service at the chain's other rooms, so what is described at 2 Pancras Square is the downstairs room rather than the whole address.

faq.question: What are the opening hours?
faq.answer: No source states the opening hours of eleven of the fourteen, so none are given for them here. Three publish theirs. Korean BBQ House on Whitecross Street gives noon to 9pm Monday to Thursday, 3pm to 10pm Friday, noon to 10pm Saturday and noon to 9pm Sunday. Kalbi on Rosebery Avenue gives 6pm to 10.30pm Monday to Thursday and 5pm to 11pm Friday to Sunday. SuperStar BBQ at Central Saint Giles gives noon to 3pm and 5pm to 11pm, Monday to Friday.

photos.title: High Street, New Malden, Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames
photos.description: A brick parade of shopfronts runs down the left side of New Malden High Street, with a rice store, a betting shop and hanging flower baskets under twin-lantern lamp posts. Cars come along the carriageway past a parking sign for the Blagdon Road multi-storey, with a railed pavement, street trees and taller office blocks beyond.
photos.author: Colin Smith

links.note: Five of the fourteen are Westminster places: Soho, Chinatown, Paddington and the Edgware Road.
Kimchee at Pancras Square and SuperStar BBQ at Central Saint Giles are Camden places.
Kalbi on Rosebery Avenue and Korean BBQ House on Whitecross Street are Islington places.
Imone BBQ is at 171 High Street, New Malden, in the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames.
